recipes.label: Traces Exposed!
recipes.startdescription: My carelessness has drawn the attention of an adversary, this could soon spell trouble—

recipes.label: Traces Exposed!
recipes.startdescription: My halt in the wilderness has exposed my trail, and this is likely to bring trouble—

recipes.label: Countermeasures...
recipes.startdescription: This hostile group has grown large enough to pose a threat—but that also makes them easier to track. Now I can devise targeted, effective countermeasures accordingly.
recipes.description: Destroying the hostile group's base will significantly reduce their threat and buy more time for my goals; when I have sufficient strength to spare, I might also consider hunting their members directly.

recipes.label: Traces of the Enemy
recipes.startdescription: This time, the enemy's careless actions have exposed their tracks...
recipes.description: This will prove useful as I plan my counterattack.

recipes.label: Traces of the Enemy
recipes.startdescription: A careful investigation of the location revealed traces of the enemy...
recipes.description: This will prove useful as I plan my counterattack.

recipes.label: Embrace of the Malachite
recipes.startdescription: My enemies are now protected by the power of the Malachite.

recipes.label: Pain Etched in Memory
recipes.startdescription: The agony from the Grail has deeply saturated this reality. My allies and I shall endure torment—

recipes.label: Pain Etched in Memory
recipes.startdescription:
The agony from the Grail has deeply saturated this reality. My allies and I shall endure torment—

[The enemy's special strategy will randomly drain a certain number of your ally or ability cards, leaving them exhausted.]

recipes.label: Pain Etched in Memory
recipes.startdescription: That searing pain leaves one dizzy and exhausted. We need time to regain our strength.

recipes.label: Edict of the Sealed Gate
recipes.startdescription: The Horned-Axe is splitting space, forcing some of my allies and resources to withdraw from the front—

recipes.label: Edict of the Sealed Gate
recipes.startdescription:
The Horned-Axe is splitting space, forcing some of my allies and resources to withdraw from the front—

[The enemy's special strategy will randomly draw a certain number of your ally and resource cards, preventing you from using them for an extended period.]

recipes.label: Lingering There
recipes.startdescription:
Barred from me by the wall of reality, these allies and resources are unable to provide aid for now—

[You cannot use trapped allies and resources for the time being.]
recipes.description: The barrier of reality finally collapses and dissolves. They can now serve me once more.

recipes.label: Velvet's Shelter
recipes.startdescription: My enemies have gained protection from the Velvet’s gifts.

recipes.label: The Plague of Gluttony
recipes.startdescription: Boundless gluttonous desire has been awakened. Everything of power that exists in this place shall be offered as tribute for the Grail to feast upon.[The huntress’ss special tactic will randomly drain a certain amount of Influence, Opportunities, and Supplies, and consume them.]

recipes.label: The Plague of Gluttony
recipes.startdescription:
Take and take, never sated—the Grail is now feasting here.

[The huntress’ss special tactic will randomly drain a certain amount of Influence, Opportunities, and Supplies, and consume them.]

recipes.label: The Plague of Gluttony
recipes.startdescription: At last, the terrible hunger of the Grail has been temporarily satisfied.

recipes.label: A Caged Beast's Fight
recipes.startdescription:
Led by the enemy, the malice of the Knot Gods has fully seeped into reality. Their immense power has forged an irresistible seal—

[You cannot leave the current area.]
recipes.description: The path of retreat is severed—I am forced to face a grueling battle.

recipes.label: Guiding Malice
recipes.startdescription:
The soil churns, shadows seethe—the power of the Velvet has been channeled to aid the huntress.

[Malice shall make the huntress more dangerous.]

recipes.label: Guiding Malice
recipes.startdescription:
Blood drips, senses sharpen—the power of the Grail has been channeled to aid the huntress.

[Malice shall make the huntress more dangerous.]

recipes.label: Depletion
recipes.startdescription: I have expended these resources to fend off the enemy’s assault—they will require time before they can be called upon again—

recipes.label: Depletion
recipes.startdescription: I have expended these resources to fend off the huntress' assault—they will require time before they can be called upon again—

recipes.label: Sight-Evoked
recipes.startdescription: I behold the world as seen by the Centipede’s eye, and I can feel the yearning that points toward the distant and the forbidden; my mind grows restless, as if something is about to transform from within—
recipes.description: That old yearning and passion are reborn from this vision.

recipes.label: It Lingers…
recipes.description:
The forbidden vision lingers in my eyes, refusing to fade. I can harness its power.

[A special Influence with no time limit! Be sure to use it well.]
